End-of-Q4 required stock not charged holding cost (integer units; continuous gives 8500)

model_summary: x1, x2 weekly units of A and B; lexicographic goal programming: profit>=3000, x1>=5, then minimize idle time weighted 12/8/10; no overtime (hard capacity). Unit profit = price minus process-hour costs (340, 609). Reported value = profit of the resulting plan.

model_summary: Integer quantities of robots, cars, blocks, dolls with 0-1 'produce' indicators; maximize profit; plastic 1200 and electronics 800; robots exclude dolls, cars imply blocks, dolls <= cars.

notes: Optimal plan: 118 cars, 1 set of blocks; the question's 'how many types' = 2 (asked_value). 'Manufacture' a type means producing at least one unit. Continuous relaxation also gives 956.

model_summary: Integer order counts from A, B, C (20/15/15 tables per order) with 0-1 usage indicators; minimize cost per table times tables; 150 <= tables <= 600; A used -> >=30 tables from B; B used -> order from C.
type_rationale: Order numbers integer, logical conditions via 0-1 variables and linear constraints; linear cost.
notes: Optimal: 10 orders from C (150 tables). Cost interpreted as per-table price times number of tables.
